mapper.insert: insert into feed_tbl(user_id , target_id, feed_type, content,visibility) values (#{userId}, #{targetId},#{feedType},#{content},#{visibility})
mapper.select:
SELECT a.feed_id, a.user_id, a.target_id, a.feed_type, a.content, a.visibility, a.created_at, a.updated_at,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_like_tbl fl WHERE fl.feed_id = a.feed_id ) AS like_count,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_comment_tbl fc WHERE fc.feed_id = a.feed_id ) AS comment_count,
b.image_id, b.feed_id, b.image_name,
d.profile_id AS sender_profile_id, d.nickname AS sender_nickname, d.stored_name AS sender_profile_image
FROM feed_tbl a
LEFT JOIN feed_image_tbl b ON a.feed_id = b.feed_id LEFT JOIN profile_tbl d ON a.user_id = d.user_id LEFT JOIN friend_tbl e ON a.user_id = e.friend_user_id AND e.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.feed_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( a.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR (e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND a.visibility = 'FRIEND') OR a.user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.feed_id, a.user_id, a.target_id, a.feed_type, a.content, a.visibility, a.created_at, a.updated_at,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_like_tbl fl WHERE fl.feed_id = a.feed_id ) AS like_count,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_comment_tbl fc WHERE fc.feed_id = a.feed_id ) AS comment_count,
b.image_id, b.feed_id, b.image_name,
d.profile_id AS sender_profile_id, d.nickname AS sender_nickname, d.stored_name AS sender_profile_image
FROM feed_tbl a
LEFT JOIN feed_image_tbl b ON a.feed_id = b.feed_id
LEFT JOIN profile_tbl d ON a.user_id = d.user_id
WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} and a.feed_status IN ('ACTIVE') ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.feed_id, a.user_id, a.target_id, a.feed_type, a.content, a.visibility, a.created_at, a.updated_at,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_like_tbl fl WHERE fl.feed_id = a.feed_id ) AS like_count,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_comment_tbl fc WHERE fc.feed_id = a.feed_id ) AS comment_count,
b.image_id, b.feed_id, b.image_name,
d.profile_id AS sender_profile_id, d.nickname AS sender_nickname, d.stored_name AS sender_profile_image
FROM feed_tbl a LEFT JOIN feed_image_tbl b ON a.feed_id = b.feed_id LEFT JOIN profile_tbl d ON a.user_id = d.user_id JOIN friend_tbl fr ON a.user_id = fr.friend_user_id WHERE fr.user_id = #{userId} AND a.visibility IN ('PUBLIC','FRIEND') and a.feed_status IN ('ACTIVE') ORDER BY a.created_at DESC;
mapper.insert: insert into feed_image_tbl(image_id, feed_id, image_name) values(#{imageId}, #{feedId}, #{imageName})
mapper.select:
SELECT a.feed_id, a.user_id, a.target_id, a.feed_type, a.content, a.visibility, a.created_at, a.updated_at,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_like_tbl fl WHERE fl.feed_id = a.feed_id ) AS like_count,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_comment_tbl fc WHERE fc.feed_id = a.feed_id ) AS comment_count,
b.image_id, b.feed_id, b.image_name,
d.profile_id AS sender_profile_id, d.nickname AS sender_nickname, d.stored_name AS sender_profile_image
FROM feed_tbl a
LEFT JOIN feed_image_tbl b ON a.feed_id = b.feed_id

WHERE a.feed_id = #{feedId}
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC;

SELECT a.transaction_id, a.receive_id, a.spending_category_id, a.transaction_type,
b.profile_id AS receiver_profile_id, b.nickname AS receiver_nickname, b.stored_name AS receiver_profile_image,
c.spending_category_id, c.category_name
FROM financial_transaction_tbl a join profile_tbl b on a.receive_id = b.user_id join spending_category_tbl c on a.spending_category_id = c.spending_category_id WHERE transaction_id = #{targetId}
SELECT a.apply_id, b.custom_image_id as cardImageName FROM card_application_history_tbl a join custom_image_tbl b on a.custom_image_id = b.custom_image_id WHERE a.apply_id = #{targetId}
SELECT spending_analysis_id, ai_title, ai_analysis_summary FROM spending_analysis_tbl WHERE spending_analysis_id = #{targetId}

SELECT a.recv_id as receiveId, a.event_id, a.reward_id, b.reward_point, c.event_img_name as eventImageName FROM event_reward_receive_tbl a join event_reward_tbl b on a.reward_id = b.reward_id join event_tbl c on a.event_id = c.event_id WHERE a.recv_id = #{targetId}
